spec.assertion: Exactly one casterAtkPct value disappears when skill1 is emptied; it lands on all 4 allies, once each, before the first shot, at a FLAT (>100) magnitude. Fails under: plain atkPct 14.08 (self-scaling), self-only/subset targets, or any trigger re-key (would re-apply per rotation). Every ally's total damage drops with the slot off.
it.skip — v1 has no HP pool (immortal boss, nothing takes damage), so 'gate permanently true' and 'no gate' are observationally identical. Modeled as an unconditional passive.

maxAmmoFlat=5 applies to 4 distinct allies exactly fullBurstStart×4 times. Fails under a burstCast key (counterfactual patch proves it strictly under-fires, since noir bursts on only ~half the team's Full Bursts) and under a self-only target.

durationShots is null and expiresFrame is finite on every apply — proving '5 round(s)' is the MAGNITUDE and '10 sec' the clock. Fails under the round-count-duration trap (durationShots:5) and under a permanent/no-expiry encoding.

Removing ONLY the instantReload effect strictly reduces noir's total damage — weapon-state is damage. Fails under 'skipped as defensive'. Slot-wide removal also moves at least one teammate's total, proving the ally-wide target rather than self.

Zeroing the flatDamage atkPct strictly lowers noir's total while all three teammates stay byte-identical. Fails if the nuke is missing (no delta) or mis-scoped to allies/self-buff (teammate movement).

hitRatePct 13.93 target set includes noir and is a STRICT subset of the 4 allies (noir is the comp's only shotgun) — fails under the 'all allies' mis-encoding. Apply count < fullBurstStart count — fails under a fullBurstEnter mis-key (helm's bursts would add applies). Removing it drops noir's damage (hit-rate→core lift) and leaves teammates identical.

Modeled for completeness as partsDamagePct on the same block (apply count equals the 13.93 count) but provably inert: stripping every partsDamagePct effect leaves all four units' totals byte-identical (v1 boss has no parts). Fails if the line were routed into a live damage bucket.

With no squad-mate in controlComp, ZERO hitRatePct-11.61 and ZERO partsDamagePct-19.36 applies. Lifting teamHas on the burst blocks makes 11.61 appear on all 4 allies and raises noir's total — the gate is real and non-vacuous. Fails if the gate was omitted (buffs would fire in a squad-mate-less comp = over-credit).

In the ungated run both hit-rate buffs are applied by the same burst cast, so expiresFrame(11.61) − expiresFrame(13.93) === 1200 frames = (30−10)s × 60fps. Fails if the 30s rider were authored at 10s (or vice versa), or as a round-count/permanent window.
Covered by the closed-gate assertion (absent in the control comp) plus the global partsDamagePct inertness sweep; no independent damage signature exists in v1.

fixtures: controlComp('noir', true) only — liter (B1) / crown (B2) / noir (B3 carry) / helm (B3), Fire boss, deterministic, 9 hoisted 180s runs (base + 8 counterfactuals: S1 off, S2 off, instantReload off, S2 trigger→burstCast, burst teamHas deleted, 13.93 hit-rate off, all partsDamagePct off, burst flatDamage zeroed). helm is kept ON deliberately: a SECOND Burst III is what makes noir's own burst casts strictly fewer than the team's Full Burst entries, which is the only way to separate skill2's fullBurstEnter keying from the burst slot's burstCast keying. Unit attribution of buffApply events is done by diffing against a counterfactual run rather than by reading a caster-id field, so a teammate carrying the same stat cannot contaminate a reading. NOTE on provenance: the redacted effect schema shipped with this packet documents the `teamHas.slugs` field with an 'ally from the same squad' example naming blanc/rouge — it does not name this unit or any of its magnitudes, so I did not treat it as a leak, but it is the reason I encode the squad gate as a slug-list team gate rather than inventing a new primitive.
gaps: skill1 '>70% HP' activation gate — it.skip: v1 has no HP pool, so a permanently-satisfied gate is observationally identical to no gate.

skill2 Max-Ammo 10s window length — it.skip: no buff is co-applied at the same frame to difference expiresFrame against, and buffApply carries no absolute frame on the documented event surface (only durationShots-null + finite-expiry are assertable).

burst 351.64% nuke Full-Burst exemption — it.skip: damage events expose inFullBurst/fbMajorApplied but the packet documents no ally-attribution field, so noir's burst-slot hits cannot be isolated from teammate damage.
Both Interruption-Part riders (23.23% / 19.36%) are asserted only as present-and-inert; partsDamagePct is parsed-but-inert in v1 (partless boss), so no magnitude check is possible.
